# This quarter's figures

*Researcher · from figures/q3.csv (31 rows: one per project per month worked)*

## Totals

| | This quarter | Last quarter |
|---|---|---|
| Projects finished | **14** | 11 |
| Hours billed | **612** | 540 |
| Handed over on the agreed date | 12 of 14 | 10 of 11 |

## By kind

| Kind | Projects | Hours |
|------|----------|-------|
| Websites | 9 | 361 |
| Reports | 3 | 187 |
| Case studies | 2 | 64 |

## Time to finish (first meeting to hand-over)

- Median: **5 weeks**
- Shortest: 2 weeks (a case study)
- Longest: 11 weeks (the Northgate Library annual report)

## Notes on the data

- Two projects that started this quarter and are not finished are left out of the totals; their 48 hours are in
  next quarter's.
- Last quarter's figures are from last quarter's summary, not recounted.
